B. The reducing agent cleaves peptide (amide) bonds, breaking the hormone into smaller polypeptides
C. The reducing agent decreases the overall charge on the hormone, causing it to bind to cell membranes unselectively
D. The reducing agent modifies the alcohol containing side chains of some of the amino acids, decreasing the affinity of the hormone for its cellular receptor
